subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- August 19, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - August 19, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS Community,

As we continue to move forward with our mission to create a user-friendly and privacy-focused Linux distribution, we want to take a moment to highlight some recent developments in the community and within our project.

Firstly, we're excited to announce that Firefox 154.0 has been released, bringing with it several improvements and security updates. This latest version includes extended local network access permissions, which will enhance the overall user experience. We recommend updating your browser to the latest version to ensure you have the most secure and efficient browsing experience.

In addition to the Firefox update, our community has been actively working on security updates for various distributions, including AlmaLinux and Debian. These updates address several vulnerabilities and ensure that our users have the latest security patches. We appreciate the hard work of our community members in keeping our ecosystem secure and up-to-date.

On the development front, our team has been working tirelessly to improve the overall performance and stability of AcreetionOS. We've been testing and refining our build processes, ensuring that our distribution is not only secure but also efficient and user-friendly. Our goal is to provide a seamless experience for our users, and we're committed to achieving that.

As we continue to grow and evolve as a community, we want to express our gratitude to our contributors, developers, and users who have made AcreetionOS what it is today. Your support and participation are invaluable to us, and we're excited to see what the future holds for our project.

In other news, our community has been actively engaging with each other on our Discord server, discussing various topics related to Linux, development, and more. We encourage everyone to join the conversation and share their thoughts, ideas, and experiences.

As we move forward, we're committed to transparency and open communication. We'll continue to share updates, news, and insights into our development process, ensuring that everyone is informed and involved.

If you have any questions, suggestions, or feedback, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. We're always here to listen and help in any way we can.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community. We're excited to see what the future holds for us, and we're grateful to have you along for the ride.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
